content:
Evelyn (partnerships): Quick kickoff: we have a 3-cloud listing task; need to lock IAM roles, cert validation plan, and trial entitlements. Tight deadline for next-week launch.

marketplace-bot: TO-DOs: create publisher account, upload pricing JSON, attach legal artifacts, set trial SKU. docs: https://portal.redwood.example/mkt/onboard :spiral_calendar:

Sam (cloud-eng): I can own AWS + GCP infra. Suggest cloud-agnostic KMS naming: redwood-marketplace-key.<newline>For AWS we'll request cross-account role 'redwood-mkt-role' and provide minimal trust/policy.

Priya (product): Packaging: default offer = metered tokens, optional Dedicated monthly SKU. Trial = 14d with 50k tokens total. Need wording for marketplace listing blurb.

Jon (legal): I'll prepare a short DPA addendum and confirm that marketplace consent covers billing reconciliation. Also flag export controls for certain model weights.

Alex (solutions): Metering note: normalize all clouds to a single 'tokens' metric. If Azure/GCP expose different primitives we'll transform at ingestion. Need a webhook sample for marketplace meter calls.

Sam (cloud-eng): Cert plan: use ACM for AWS endpoints, GCP-managed certs for load balancer, Azure KeyVault certs. We'll include CNAME/TXT templates for validation.

Evelyn (partnerships): Action items: Sam (IAM + cert templates) EOD; Priya (listing copy + assets) 48h; Jon (DPA + terms) 48h; Alex (metering webhook + SDK sample) EOD. Sync tomorrow 11am PT.

marketplace-bot: publisher created -> id: pub-1799 :white_check_mark:

Priya (product): Slight tweak: trial entitlement to be capped per-account, not per-day, to prevent abuse. Setting to 50k total.

Jon (legal): Noted. I'll add a clause for trial abuse & entitlement revocation.

Evelyn (partnerships): Thanks team — will compile the onboarding playbook and share link after sync. :rocket:
